verdict.rationale: Expensify's own docs say scanned receipts match card transactions automatically with no manual matching. They also say digital receipts can be imported automatically from integrations like Uber. Nothing in the pack covers the third part of the story: targeted nudges sent only when a receipt is genuinely missing. Missing for 10: documented missing-receipt notifications that fire only for real gaps, the breadth of e-receipt integrations beyond Uber, and independent or hands-on corroboration of auto-matching accuracy.

support.subject: As an employee, receipts match to card transactions automatically — with e-receipts pulled from integrations — and I get nudged only when one is genuinely missing

citations.quote: The scanned receipt matches to the card transaction automatically, with no manual matching or duplicate entries.
automatically import digital receipts from integrations like Uber
Just import your existing cards into Expensify.
